verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any first-party natural-language command interface for operating Google Drive. The only AI-related item describes building an AI agent add-on with ADK and Vertex AI Agent Engine. That is a developer building block for constructing such a capability, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
